row_check.notes: All non-empty columns evidenced. outcome_construct 'both' is sound: SCA is measured with its own validated scale (SCA1-3, AVE 0.878) and dedicated hypotheses, per case law. Two caveats for the author: (1) the text extraction drops minus signs in Table 6 - the TR->VC and DC->VC paths are negative per the discussion text ('negatively impacts', 'negative relationship') though the table shows bare 0.275/0.385; (2) the abstract claims technology readiness 'positively influence[s] value creation' while the paper's own H2 result is negative - an internal inconsistency of the paper, not of the coding, since effect_direction is coded on the AI-adoption path (positive, quoted).
